fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder (g0042, near 0x710068a22c) stores vptr 0x7104f6d720 (only class, 896 bytes); module stored at boma+0x158. The same vptr is also built in other object builders (g0028, g0035).

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the boma beside the vptr; the activation slot (+0x38) reads the owner battle object id (boma+0x8) and TeamModule (boma+0xD8) through it; check_rebound reaches boma+0x38 (PostureModule) through it.

fields.name: grab_num
fields.evidence: Setup slot +0x28 (f_710045b780) copies desc+0x8/+0x10 into +0x10/+0x18. clear_all (+0x50), the activation slot and relocate loop over this many records.

fields.name: grabs
fields.evidence: Array of grab-box records, stride 0x50, indexed by the id argument of is_grab, size, set_size, node, clear and the add/set slots. Slot +0xA0 returns the record's address.

fields.name: active_num
fields.evidence: Constructor 0; the add slot (+0x60, f_710045b9b0) increments it; clear (+0x58) decrements it when the record was live; clear_all and activation zero it. Update (+0xC8) and sleep skip work when 0.

fields.name: pos
fields.evidence: pos_x (+0x90) loads the f32 at +0x30 (certain for that float). The activation slot (+0x38), update (+0xC8, f_710045bfc0) and relocate (+0xF0) store a 16-byte position here; relocate also moves every live shape by (new - old) x/y.

fields.name: scale
fields.evidence: Activation stores s0; update stores s0 * scale_2nd (+0x44). Used by the add slot when the shape is created (passed with the record's node).

fields.name: scale_2nd
fields.evidence: set_scale_2nd (+0xC0) stores s0. Constructor and activation 1.0. update multiplies its scale argument by it before storing +0x40.

fields.name: power_up
fields.evidence: set_power_up (+0xB0) stores s0. Constructor 1.0. set_size (+0x88) stores arg * this into the record's size; the add slot multiplies the record's size by this and size_mul.

fields.name: lr
fields.evidence: Activation stores s1, update stores s1. When check_front (+0x36D) is set, the hit filter (slot +0xD8, f_710045c740) rejects targets with (target_x - grab_x) * lr < 0 (behind the grabber).

fields.name: size_mul
fields.evidence: set_size_mul (+0xB8) stores s0. Constructor and activation 1.0. Multiplies the record size in the add slot.

fields.name: collision_list_node
fields.evidence: 0x58..0x67 embedded list/registration object: slot +0x40 (f_710045b8a0, deactivate) calls the list-remove helper on this+0x58, the add slot registers it.

fields.name: collision_group_num
fields.evidence: Activation stores 1 (one collision group).

fields.name: collision_groups
fields.evidence: Activation stores this+0x98 (the embedded collision group). center_pos (+0x98) reads [this+0x70]+0x30+8*id -> shape object -> vfunc +0x20 -> 16-byte position. Slot +0xD8 reads [+0x70]+0x2AC.

fields.name: collision_attr
fields.evidence: Constructor 0, activation 1 (with +0x7C = 6).

fields.name: target_category_shift
fields.evidence: Constructor -1, activation 6 (same role as ReflectorModule +0x78).

fields.name: owner_object_id
fields.evidence: Constructor 0x50000000 (invalid id); activation stores the owner battle object id; deactivate (+0x40) resets it to 0x50000000. Update reads it.

fields.name: owner_category
fields.evidence: Constructor 6; activation stores owner id >> 28.

fields.name: team_info
fields.evidence: Activation stores TeamModule (boma+0xD8) vtable +0x98 result; slots +0x190/+0x198 copy it to +0x90.

fields.name: team_info_2
fields.evidence: Written by slots +0x190/+0x198 from +0x88. Constructor zeroes 0x88..0x93 and activation zeroes +0x92.

fields.name: collision_group
fields.evidence: Embedded collision-group record 0x98..0x367 (stride-0x2D0 type also used by Reflector/Absorber/Shield modules): starts with an object pointer 0x7104f6aed8; +0xA8 a fixed array object (0x7104f6aef8, count/capacity 0x40 at +0xB0/+0xB8, data pointer +0xC0 -> inline storage +0xC8..+0x2C7 = 64 shape-object pointers, zeroed by memset); intrusive lists at +0x2C8 (count +0x2D8), +0x2E0 (count +0x2F0), +0x2F8/+0x310/+0x328 (count +0x338); +0x340 a serial from a global counter; +0x344 grab x (relocate writes it); +0x354 u16 0xFFFF; +0x360 u64 0. Slots +0x10/+0x18 return this+0x98.

fields.name: grab_kind
fields.evidence: Constructor 6; setup copies desc+0x0.

fields.name: is_active_flag
fields.evidence: Activation (+0x38) stores its bool arg; the add slot / update test it.

fields.name: check_front
fields.evidence: set_check_front (export -> slot +0xF8, f_710045cd90) stores arg&1; setup copies desc+0x4. Enables the facing test in the hit filter (+0xD8).

fields.name: update_pending
fields.evidence: Update (+0xC8) sets it when there is nothing live or the module sleeps; cleared by slot +0x48; the add slot checks it before registering the shape immediately.

fields.name: is_sleep
fields.evidence: sleep (export -> slot +0xE0, f_710045c940) stores arg&1 after walking the shapes; unexported getter +0xE8 returns it. is_grab returns false while set; activation clears 0x36F..0x372 (u32 zero).

fields.name: rebound
fields.evidence: is_rebound (+0x108) returns it; set_rebound (export -> slot +0x100) stores arg&1.

fields.name: flag_0x371
fields.evidence: Unexported setter +0x110 (arg&1) / getter +0x118. check_rebound tests slot +0x118 on both objects.

fields.name: disable_sub_fighter
fields.evidence: disable_sub_fighter (+0x128, f_710045ce90) sets 1; clear_all clears it; the hit filter (+0xD8) tests it.

fields.name: grab.offset
fields.evidence: Slot +0x68 (f_710045be20) stores the x/y of a vector arg (z/w zero) when the record is live, returns whether it was.

fields.name: grab.size
fields.evidence: size (+0x80) loads it; set_size (+0x88) stores arg * power_up (+0x48); the add slot rescales it by power_up * size_mul.

fields.name: grab.node
fields.evidence: node (+0xA8) returns the 64-bit value (joint hash); passed to the shape builder by the add slot.

fields.name: grab.constraint
fields.evidence: set_constraint (export -> slot +0x70, f_710045be70) stores arg&1 when the record is live.

fields.name: grab.status
fields.evidence: is_grab (+0x78) = !is_sleep && status != 0; clear (+0x58) zeroes it and decrements active_num; clear_all and activation zero all of them; the add slot sets it.

pointers.to: grab records[grab_num], stride 0x50 (from the resource descriptor)

notes: One class (0x7104f6d720, 896 bytes). Setup +0x28 takes a descriptor (desc+0x0 -> +0x368, +0x4 -> +0x36D, +0x8/+0x10 -> +0x10/+0x18). Activation +0x38 (f_710045b7b0, pos vector, s0 scale, s1 lr, bool) and update +0xC8 (f_710045bfc0) rewrite pos/scale/lr. center_pos is computed by the collision shape object, not stored here. check_rebound (+0x120) is computed: both objects' slot +0x108/+0x118 flags, then the product of both PostureModule (boma+0x38) vtable +0xB0 values (lr) must be negative (facing each other). Unnamed offsets 0x24..0x2F are never touched by the methods read (padding/unused).
